layout: The meme is composed of four panels. Panels are arranged in two rows, each with two panels.
character_position: Characters are centered in each panel, occupying approximately 40-60% of each panel. The first character appears on the left, and the purple character is on the right.

text_style.color: Black text on white and light gray backgrounds.
text_style.position: Speech bubbles and text are placed near the corresponding characters.

content_structure: The meme follows a conversation-reaction format. The first panel sets up a positive event, and the last panel reveals an unforeseen issue with a humorous twist.
description: A multi-panel meme featuring a conversation between two characters. The left character reports success, while the right one initially reacts positively before learning unexpected news in the last panel.
